description: Statutory employer cost of one employee in a country, before any EOR fee: each employer contribution with its rate, base, ceiling, official source and check date, then the monthly and annual total and its percent of gross. A total the country declares as a floor or a ceiling is written "at least" or "at most". Data snapshot 2026-10-06. Cost comparison, not legal or tax advice.

assumptions.description: Override an adjustable assumption the country declares, e.g. {"basic_share_of_gross": 0.6}. See `assumptions` in an employer_cost answer.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("DE") or country name ("Germany")

include_notes.description: Include the long legal note behind each line

salary.description: Gross annual salary. Omit to use the country's example salary.

salary_currency.description: Currency of `salary`: USD, or the local currency of the country

name: employer_cost
title: Statutory employer cost
